description.value: Statue of Liberty / Ellis Island tour candidate uses Statue City Cruises, the only ferry service to Liberty and Ellis Islands, departing from Castle Clinton in Battery Park or Liberty State Park in Jersey City. Every ferry ticket includes the Statue of Liberty Museum and the Ellis Island National Museum of Immigration. Pedestal and crown access must be bought in advance, and the crown climb is 162 steps with no elevator. The National Park Service recommends an early ferry to see both islands in one day, and security waits can run an hour or more in summer.
